request: SearchNavigationTest#homeBackAsksBeforeLeavingTheApp passed alone 1/3: the first Back on Home did not open the exit question; find the root cause and fix it
rootCause: Product: PilotApp had two BackHandlers (Home: exitAsk; others: model.back()). BackHandler updates its enabled flag in a SideEffect, so after the model reaches HOME the previous route's handler stays enabled until the next composition is applied. The first Home frame after an import took 0.1-0.4 s; a Back in that gap reached the LOADING handler, whose model.back() does nothing on HOME, and was lost. The same gap could swallow a quick Back after returning Home from the library or a detail page, and on Home a Back right after leaving it raised a question that was then dropped.

Platform (test only): after the question closes, the system keeps input focus on the removed dialog window for about 100 ms; keys sent then are dropped before reaching the app. The test sent the next Back as soon as the dialog left the Compose tree.
evidence: Run without probes (failing): CoreBackPreview shows the androidx callback re-registered at 08.638 (general handler disabled, Home handler enabled = HOME composed), 0.38 s after the test's dumpsys input_method at 08.263 that directly precedes its Back.

Temporary probe logs (removed afterwards), failing run: test sends Back 11.215 with model=HOME; the general handler receives it 11.227; HOME is composed 11.339. Passing runs: the Back reaches the Home handler.

Class run after the product fix: the third Back failed instead; InputDispatcher logged 'Not creating InputTarget for <dialog window>, no input channel' twice (DOWN/UP) 83-85 ms after the dialog's back callback was removed.
changes: ui/PilotApp.kt: the Home and general handlers are one BackHandler with the same enabled routes (now including HOME); it decides by model.state.value.route when Back arrives: HOME -> exit question, otherwise model.back(). No platform callback re-registration on LOADING -> HOME any more.
testChanges: SearchNavigationTest: new backFollowsTheModelRouteBeforeTheScreenCatchesUp changes the route and dispatches Back in the same main-thread turn (Library -> Home asks; Home -> Library returns Home without asking). Old product code 0/2 (exit question never opens), fixed code 3/3 alone and passing in both class runs.
SearchNavigationTest.homeBackAsksBeforeLeavingTheApp: closed() also waits until Home's window has window focus again before the next key.
